items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Well, yeah, he was in that world, too.

ctx.x: What about Joe Rene? Was he in the home or out?
Well, yeah, he was in that world, too.
Yeah, but not with you, huh? No, no. And he was in the brass band, too, though, wasn't he? Yeah, that's right, the Zulus. We got an interview with him, too. Excuse me.
